sloka: वनं कुरुषु यद्दिव्यं वासोभूषणपत्ऺत्रवत् ।दिव्यनारीफलं शश्वत्तत्कौबेरमिहैतु च ॥ २.९१.१९॥
transliteration: vanaṁ kuruṣu yaddivyaṁ vāsobhūṣaṇapatऺtravat ।divyanārīphalaṁ śaśvattatkauberamihaitu ca ॥ 2.91.19॥

translations.english: Let Kubera's divine forest situated in the land of Kurus, where leaves serve as raiment and ornaments and celestial women as its fruits come here.
